newsitem.title: UK: Suspect in Irish journalist murder on drugs charge.
newsitem.headline: Suspect in Irish journalist murder on drugs charge.

text.p: A man who identified himself as a suspect in the killing of an Irish investigative journalist has been charged under Britain's Drug Trafficking Act.

Customs officials said Irishman John Gilligan, detained at London's Heathrow airport when about to board a flight to the Netherlands, was charged on Monday night with "concealment of money in order to avoid a drugs trafficking offence".
He is due to appear in a London court on Tuesday, the officials said.
Campaigning Dublin journalist Veronica Guerin was shot dead in June by two men on a motobrike who were believed to be contract killers working for the Irish capital's drug barons.
Gilligan, 44, said in a newspaper interview soon after the shooting that he recognised he was a "prime suspect" for involvement in the crime, but denied any link to the murder.
But he did admit to making threats to kill, kidnap and assault Guerin, saying they were meant to intimidate the journalist into ending her investigation of his activities.
